guides.title: Persona overrides · Visual avatar tags
guides.description: Inspect Visual avatar tags overrides for the selected Persona.

steps.title: Read Visual avatar tags
steps.body: Read how visual avatar tags map to the available avatar choices. Inherited choices follow the shared setup; a Persona override can select different assets where supported. Check the effective value and validation before saving. A mapping does not prepare missing avatar files.

steps.title: Resolve the override draft
steps.body: Review any validation message and compare the draft with the effective settings before saving or discarding. Keep the selected Persona in view. A saved value records the configuration; successful behavior needs a later controlled exercise with the required providers ready.

steps.title: Read TTS voice provider tags
steps.body: Read the voice-provider and reference routing for this Persona's tags. A configured mapping needs a compatible speech backend and available reference. Distinguish inherited settings from an override. Preserve the current draft before comparing another route; a later spoken reply is the routing test.

steps.title: Resolve the override draft
steps.body: Review any validation message and compare the draft with the effective settings before saving or discarding. Keep the selected Persona in view. A saved value records the configuration; successful behavior needs a later controlled exercise with the required providers ready.

steps.title: Read Language model
steps.body: Read this Persona's language-model override and the effective provider/model. An override differs from changing the shared active provider. Check connection prerequisites and validation before saving. If the intended model is unavailable, keep inheritance while repairing that setup separately.

steps.title: Resolve the override draft

steps.title: Read Conversation memory
steps.body: Read the Persona's memory override alongside the inherited configuration. This controls how memory is used for the Persona; it does not edit the saved chat or import Document Memory files. Keep the current values noted before changing a limit or retrieval choice.

guides.title: Persona overview
guides.description: Identity instructions, voice references, visual identity and per-Persona overrides.

steps.title: Understand a saved Persona
steps.body: A Persona brings together identity instructions, voice references and visual identity. The active prompt determines the current instructions; a generated draft or library entry remains separate until applied. This overview stays on the identity page and introduces the related categories.

steps.title: Choose one category to learn
steps.body: Voice handles references, MCP handles tool selections, Overrides handles Persona-specific runtime choices, and Visual identity and Visual replies cover appearance and image policy. Prompt library and Identity Relay keep reusable or imported material. Choose a focused guide after finishing; none starts automatically.
